pshaw: “I was sitting in the library waiting for a ‘date’—doesn’t that sound awful?—and then all of a sudden I thought, ‘pshaw, I don’t want to be bothered!

What 's dat stan'in' by de fence?
Pshaw! why don't I lu'n some sense?
Git up, Suke--go long!

And, into which, you cannot see an inch
Although you beat your head against it—pshaw!

‘Now, pshaw!’ returned the other in a heat,
A little fretted by being called ‘young friend,’
